scientific_integrity: The analytic proof determines the entire disk and all nondegenerate maximizing vector moduli. The p=4 reversal uses exact rational polynomial sign comparisons; numerical samples are not claimed as exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Complex three-coordinate spaces only, 1<p<infinity; no longer-shift or general-matrix classification. The finite numerical checks supplement, and do not replace, the analytic global maximization proof. The inspected sources do not exclude every unpublished or unindexed equivalent.
title: Exact mixed-exponent numerical ranges of three-site weighted shifts on \(\ell_p\)
